response.rationale: Several items support elaboration-type processing aiding retention (generation effect meta-analysis, concept maps, elaborative interrogation and self-explanation rated moderate utility, and involvement load), but the evidence is indirect and mixed: keyword and imagery mnemonics are rated low, rote pairs beat semantic mapping in Sagarra 2006, and learner highlighting does not help comprehension, so "elaboration predicts retention" is only partly and non-uniformly supported.
